scenarioOrder: Serial; satisfy control/one-round gates before salvo

cases.name: compile-current-composition
cases.expected: Fresh staged source validates without GEP script errors; normal owned exit; no gameplay claim

cases.name: ordinary-stock-control
cases.expected: Ordinary on-foot throw of AN-M8 visibly flies, fuses and emits native white smoke
cases.stopGate: Stop before candidate if control fails

cases.name: one-round-first-gate
cases.expected: Settled gunner action dispatches exactly one native round, 8->7; actual departure/clearance, fuse and visible cloud observed
cases.stopGate: Stop; no salvo if any flight/fuse/cloud failure

cases.name: cooldown-and-empty
cases.expected: Retry below2.5s dispatches0; after cooldown salvo dispatches7, 7->0; empty request dispatches0

cases.name: reload-transaction
cases.expected: On-foot stopped target; 3s action consumes1 stowed AN-M8 and credits1 tube on completion only; canceled/rejected/duplicate completion cannot add extras
cases.stopGate: Do not clear uncertain pending transaction

cases.name: roles-and-rejection
cases.expected: Gunner and commander settled in this turret can fire; driver/on-foot/other vehicle/dead/transition rejects; moving/full/no-item reload rejects

cases.name: heading-and-clearance
cases.expected: One-round flight clears vehicle at representative turret headings/elevations; shell/crew not hit
cases.stopGate: No collision workaround to disguise failure

cases.name: released-regression
cases.expected: Accepted driving/reverse/braking, stock cannon audio, HUD, exit/reentry operate normally on optional child

cases.name: remote-and-jip
cases.expected: Authority and remote see same projectile/fuse/cloud/count; late peer sees current remaining effect without replay
cases.stopGate: NOT_TESTED: single-player overlay intentionally cannot establish this
